seoTitle: Change the Timezone on Your TradingView Charts
metaDescription: Learn how to change your chart timezone in TradingView on mobile and web, and how it affects candle timestamps, alerts, and bar replay.
intro: Setting the correct timezone on TradingView keeps candle timestamps and indicator plots aligned with your local time or the market you're analyzing. This guide covers accessing chart settings, choosing a timezone, and understanding how the change affects alerts and saved layouts.

steps.heading: Open chart settings
steps.body: Access the chart settings menu on either the mobile app or the website to find the timezone options.

steps.heading: Select your timezone
steps.body: Choose from global timezones such as GMT, EST, or IST depending on the region you're trading or analyzing.

steps.heading: Understand the effect on candles
steps.body: Changing the timezone shifts candle timestamps and how indicator plots line up on the chart.

steps.heading: Sync across saved layouts
steps.body: Apply the timezone change consistently across your saved chart layouts so your setups stay aligned.

steps.heading: Check bar replay and alerts
steps.body: Be aware that timezone changes can affect bar replay sessions and the timing of your alerts.

steps.heading: Confirm the setting is saved
steps.body: Make sure the timezone change is saved to your account so it carries over into future sessions and devices.

faq.question: Why does timezone matter on TradingView charts?
faq.answer: The timezone affects candle timestamps and indicator plots, which is important for accurate analysis when trading across regions.

faq.question: Can I set a different timezone on mobile than on web?
faq.answer: You can change it on either, but syncing your account keeps the setting consistent across mobile and web.

faq.question: Does changing timezone affect my alerts?
faq.answer: Yes, timezone changes can impact how your alerts and bar replay sessions are timed.

faq.question: Is this useful for forex and crypto traders?
faq.answer: Yes, stock, crypto, and forex traders working across multiple time zones benefit from setting a consistent timezone.

faq.question: Will my timezone setting be saved for future sessions?
faq.answer: Yes, once set and synced to your account, the timezone should carry over to future sessions on any device.
